tables.name: Population Wealth
tables.description: Modified by Condition and Prosperity. Modifies Crime and Quality. The minuses to crime are desperation when wealth is low, greed when it is high.

results.name: Destitute
results.description: Nearly everyone in town consistently lacks the barest essentials of what they need to survive. (-4 to crime roll) (-2 to quality rolls)

results.name: Impoverished
results.description: Around half of the town struggles to carve out even a meager existence. (-2 to crime roll) (-1 to quality rolls)

results.name: Average
results.description: Most of the town’s population have enough to live a modest life. Those without are a minority. (+0 to crime roll) (+0 to quality rolls)

results.name: Prosperous
results.description: The majority have enough to live a good life and, of them, a fair amount can even live comfortably. (-1 to crime roll) (+1 to quality rolls)

results.name: Wealthy
results.description: Nearly everyone has what they need to live comfortably, many are able to live well, and some are very prosperous. (-2 to crime roll) (+2 to quality rolls)

results.name: Affluent
results.description: The entire town is able to live comfortably, with a significant portion living in luxury. (-3 to crime roll) (+3 to quality rolls)
